verdict.rationale: Alloy's homepage markets Fraud Signal, its own machine-learning model that produces adaptive fraud-risk signals, plus agentic automation for KYC/KYB/AML checks. That is first-party AI applied to customer data inside the product, but the evidence is marketing-level only. Nothing shows natural-language insights, recommendations or suggestions surfaced to the user. Missing for 10: documented AI-generated insights or suggestions in the dashboard, detail on what Fraud Signal outputs and how users see it, documentation of the agentic automation's behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Ditch static rules for Fraud Signal, our machine learning model that adapts as threats evolve
Streamline perpetual KYC/KYB, AML, and fraud checks with fully auditable agentic automation
Monitor your portfolio continuously with real-time risk signals
